turns.text: Lloyd, I'm trying to benchmark the new MoE models. I loaded up the 26B model on my test rig yesterday.
That's a solid choice for local testing. How was the initial load time?

Slower than I hoped, mostly due to disk IO. But once it was running, the throughput was impressive. It has 26B total parameters with a 4B active footprint, so the inference speed is way better than a dense model of that size.
Exactly, that sparse activation is the key advantage for consumer hardware. Did you manage to fit it on the GPU VRAM?
Barely. I had to offload some layers to CPU. Speaking of hardware, did you get that quote for the new monitor stand I asked about?
Yes, the ergonomic arm is in stock and ships tomorrow. Shall I place the order?
Go ahead. Also, check if there's a rain forecast for the weekend; I might want to take the dog out.
Order placed. Forecast says sunny with a high of 75°F on Saturday. Perfect for a walk.
